summary: Verification-only phase re-proving 115M's Repository Skills evidence-acquisition adapter (src/pcae/core/repository_skills_integration.py) is fully behavior-preserving. Adds 62 new tests (tests/test_repository_skills_integration_verification_115n.py) proving: per-skill evidence equivalence (each of the four deterministic skills individually matches its Evidence-ID-prefixed subset of the direct provider path, via 115M's own public API); full EvaluationResult equality between provider-path and skill-path contexts on both a synthetic mostly-UNKNOWN repository and the real project root (identical invariant_results, blocking_failures, warnings, informational, explanation_reference, summary); unchanged validate_transition verdicts across the 113U/115F regression scenarios plus CERTIFIED/BLOCKED->CANONICAL promotion decisions, with the validator's own adapter evidence IDs remaining a subset of the richer skill-path evidence; lifecycle compatibility confirmed at the source level (no lifecycle command, Notification Policy, Canonical Artifact Promotion, Push-State Reconciliation, or Post-Push Canonicalization references repository_skills at all) plus unmodified passage of the existing phase-complete/task-finish/notification/report-generation integration suites; deterministic registry ordering, invocation order, order-independent merge, duplicate-skill-id rejection, and stable lookup; the old Evidence Provider compatibility path fully functional and provider required_inputs unchanged; Repository Skills isolation (read-only, creates no files, no commit/push/finalize/notify/authorize/execute/mutate function, never calls evaluate() itself, no verdict/authorization field on any result type); the AI boundary (no DeepSeek/GLM/Qwen/Claude/GPT/Codex/SLM skill id, no model-produced evidence, AI_REVIEW capability has zero registered skills); and the execution boundary (E-runtime-002 = 'unavailable' via both paths, runtime_execution_unavailable invariant PASSes, pcae runtime inspect reports Observed/observe/unavailable). Investigates and classifies 115M's 4389/4390 fast_green result: the one failure (test_dry_run_simulation.py::test_pytest_dry_run_not_blocked) is a pre-existing, idle-state-dependent condition in core/permission_broker.py's _broker_decide (a plain `python -m pytest ...` command hard-blocks via would_block_by_task_contract whenever no active task is present) -- reproduced deterministically against a synthetic tmp_path with/without a tasks/active/ directory, confirmed unrelated to 115M/115N (neither references permission_broker/advisory/shell_gate/dry_run), and confirmed to disappear (4390/4390) when this phase's own fast_green run had an active task present. Zero implementation change; no Repository Skill, Evidence Provider, Decision Evaluation, Repository Transition Validator, lifecycle command, Notification Policy, Canonical Artifact Promotion, Push-State Reconciliation, or Post-Push Canonicalization modified. Execution capability remains unavailable.
tests_added_or_updated: 62 new verification tests added (tests/test_repository_skills_integration_verification_115n.py) covering evidence equivalence per skill, Decision Evaluation compatibility, Transition Validator compatibility, lifecycle compatibility, registry verification, compatibility path verification, isolation verification, AI boundary verification, execution boundary verification, and the fast_green discrepancy investigation; all pre-existing suites (evidence/decision_evaluation/repository_skills/repository_transition_validator, task/phase/notification suites including the known-slow test_phase85/87_integration.py, runtime/contract/autonomy/plugin suites, fast_green) pass unmodified
